overview.title: Data explorer
overview.description: Tables you can read, grouped by database schema.
overview.emptyText: Your CMS role does not grant read access to any table yet. Ask an administrator to assign you the permissions you need.

access.mfaRequiredHeading: Two-factor verification or an active CMS account is required
access.mfaRequiredText: The CMS only opens for staff with an active CMS account whose session has passed two-factor verification. Verify your second factor to continue. If you have not set one up yet, add it from your profile settings; if the problem persists, your CMS account may have been deactivated.
access.loadErrorHeading: The CMS could not be loaded
access.loadErrorText: Something went wrong while contacting the CMS. Please try again in a moment.
